messages:
alex: starting staged rollout v7.3.0 -> 10% to ap-northeast-1. deploy-bot, initiate canary. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. thresholds: 5xx +3% sustained 5m or p95 > 250ms => HOLD

deploy-bot: canary started: target=ap-northeast-1 traffic=10% version=v7.3.0 started_at=1799999000

sara: oncall here, watching dashboards. tagging infra to watch cache eviction and deploy pods

jin: seeing a small p95 spike at ~1799999030, p95 210ms, 5xx down. digging into traces now

alex: if p95 crosses 250ms or 5xx >= +3% for 5m, issue HOLD and pin region back to v7.2.9. call it explicitly

jin: logs show increased DB tail latency for a subset of requests hitting new index path, not full site-wide. recommending HOLD for further investigation

alex: HOLD requested. @deploy-bot pin ap-northeast-1 -> v7.2.9 and halt rollout. do not advance to 25%

deploy-bot: HOLD acknowledged. pinning region and scaling down canary pods. estimated drain ~2-4m

ops-bot: rollback playbook note posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback. expect transient latency during drain

sara: confirmed hold. monitoring. will post if any 5xx surge occurs

alex: will schedule short follow-up to validate fix before re-running canary. thanks team

deploy-bot: pin complete at 1799999072. traffic restored to v7.2.9 in ap-northeast-1
